title: Future Tense — Simple (będę robić)
explanation: The imperfective future tense in Polish is formed with the auxiliary verb 'być' (to be) in its future forms plus the infinitive or past participle of the main verb. Future forms of 'być': będę (I will), będziesz (you will), będzie (he/she/it will), będziemy (we will), będziecie (you pl. will), będą (they will). Combine with infinitive: będę pracować (I will work). Alternatively, use będę + past participle (gender-specific): będę pracował/pracowała. Note: perfective verbs form the future tense differently using present-tense endings.

examples.english: Tomorrow I will work at home.
She will read in the evening.
We will travel in the summer.

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'I will work tomorrow' (pracować = to work)?
exercises.explanation: The imperfective future is formed with będę + infinitive: będę pracować. Option B is present tense, C is past tense, D is grammatically incorrect.

exercises.prompt: Complete with the future tense: 'She will read a book' (czytać = to read)
exercises.explanation: 3rd person singular future of 'być': będzie. So: Ona będzie czytać książkę.

exercises.prompt: Which future form is correct for 'they' (oni) + 'podróżować' (to travel)?
exercises.explanation: 3rd person plural future of 'być': będą. Oni będą podróżować (they will travel).

exercises.prompt: Complete: 'We will cook dinner.' (gotować = to cook)
exercises.explanation: 1st person plural future of 'być': będziemy. Będziemy gotować obiad.

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'You (informal, singular) will listen to music'?
exercises.explanation: 2nd person singular future of 'być': będziesz. Będziesz słuchać muzyki.
